summary.prose: Building this Story is three small, independent code/doc edits to src/workflow/chain.ts and docs/workflow.md, followed by one test task that extends the existing chain.ts test suite. Nothing here needs new infrastructure: every fix reuses functions/imports already present (listAmendments, amendmentPath), and every test extends an existing fixture-backed test file. The riskiest piece is review-amendment's new real-artifact lookup (t2); everything else is a mechanical string swap.

tasks.title: chain.ts: replace the 6 mechanical dead-string approve-*/sync-tracker sites with real MCP call shapes
tasks.summary: In computeNextAction, swap the 6 return sites at lines 341, 356, 378, 399, 422 (approve-define x2, approve-hld, approve-lld x2) and 438 (sync-tracker) from `insrc workflow approve/sync ...` to insrc_workflow_approve({artifactPath:"<real path>"}) / insrc_workflow_step(phase='start', workflow='tracker.sync', params={epicHash}) -- pure string swaps, no new data needed, no existing test's .command.includes(...) assertion content changes (the real path string is still embedded).
acceptanceChecks: Every one of the 6 sites' command string matches insrc_workflow_approve({artifactPath:...}) or insrc_workflow_step(phase='start', workflow='tracker.sync', ...) and still contains the real artifact path / epicHash it always did.
No other NextAction kind's command string (run-define, run-hld, run-lld, push-tracker) changes.

tests.name: computeNextAction returns insrc_workflow_approve/insrc_workflow_step call shapes (not the dead insrc-workflow-CLI strings) for approve-define, approve-hld, approve-lld and sync-tracker, across both the main and issue-anchored branches

tasks.title: chain.ts: thread firstPendingAmendment through buildChainReport/NextActionInput and fix review-amendment
tasks.summary: Add firstPendingAmendment to NextActionInput, computed in buildChainReport from listAmendments(repoPath, epicHash) filtered to status==='pending' (first in existing deterministic order) mapped via amendmentPath. Update computeNextAction's review-amendment branch (lines 382-388) to return the real amendmentId + a command naming insrc_present + insrc_workflow_approve with that real path, with the non-throwing placeholder fallback for the race case where firstPendingAmendment is undefined despite amendments.pending > 0.
acceptanceChecks: With one pending AMD artifact present, review-amendment's amendmentId equals that artifact's real id and command names its real path.
With two pending AMD artifacts present, review-amendment names the FIRST in AMD-<hash>-<n> ascending order.
With zero pending amendments, review-amendment's branch is never entered (unchanged behavior).
ChainReport.amendments's public shape ({pending,approved,rejected}) and countAmendments()'s return type are unchanged.

tests.name: computeNextAction's review-amendment names a real pending AMD artifact's id and path, selects the FIRST when several are pending, is never entered when none are pending, and never throws in the race-case fallback

tasks.title: docs/workflow.md: rewrite the two amendment sections' CLI examples to the real mechanism
tasks.summary: Replace the invented `insrc workflow amend <h16> --list/--show/--approve/--reject` code blocks at lines 298-311 and 445-451 with the real mechanism (discover the pending AMD artifact, then insrc_present + insrc_workflow_approve), leaving the surrounding AMD-lifecycle prose unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Neither section contains the string 'insrc workflow amend' afterward.
The surrounding prose describing the AMD pending/approved/rejected lifecycle is unchanged.

tests.name: Manual inspection: docs/workflow.md's two amendment sections no longer contain the string 'insrc workflow amend' and the surrounding AMD-lifecycle prose is unchanged (no automated test harness exists for this doc)

tasks.title: Extend chain.test.ts to assert the corrected command content for t1 and t2
tasks.summary: Add/extend assertions in src/workflow/__tests__/chain.test.ts (reusing the existing fixture helper) proving t1's 6 corrected sites and t2's review-amendment fix, while confirming chain-issue-anchored.test.ts's existing assertions (notably line 225's `.command.includes('DEF.md')`) still pass unmodified.
acceptanceChecks: New/updated test cases in chain.test.ts cover every acceptance check named in t1 and t2.
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts is run and its existing assertions pass with zero edits.

tests.name: chain.test.ts's new/updated assertions for t1 and t2 pass, and chain-issue-anchored.test.ts's existing assertions (including line 225's DEF.md check) pass unmodified

epicImpact.reason: Standalone Story, first and only Story of this Epic; no prior BUILD to analyse.
